claim_boundary: E2 tests a computational boundary condition and does not establish brain geometry or biology.
Synthetic success cannot overwrite the frozen ABIDE-I result.
No smoke, partial run, or unaudited artifact is a scientific result.

data.signal: class-paired node marginals; class 1 is smooth on the true graph and class 0 is a per-subject node permutation

families.S1_recoverable_geometry: fixed node-specific O(2) frames disclosed only through a label-independent frame marker
families.S2_incorrect_topology: S1 features evaluated on a fixed degree-matched permuted topology
families.S3_shuffled_geometry: S1 signal frames with frame markers assigned to the wrong nodes
families.S4_transport_noise: S1 signal frames with marker-frame angular corruption at 0, 15, 30, 60, and 120 degrees
families.S5_unlearnable_subject_frames: subject-specific signal frames with no informative frame marker; oracle maps remain available only to the oracle control
families.S6_global_feature_analogue: S1 plus a replicated true-graph total-variation summary in half of the signal bundles

shared_architecture.encoder: fixed identity so ground-truth frames remain identifiable

primary_estimand: [(learned_bunn - gcn) in S1] - [(learned_bunn - gcn) in S0] on test balanced accuracy, paired by replicate seed

primary_inference.interval: paired percentile bootstrap across replicate seeds

required_validity_gates: learned_bunn is compared with both gcn and learned_local in S1
S0 detects a generic capacity or optimization advantage
S2, S3, S4, and S5 test degradation under broken topology, marker geometry, and learnability
all generator and operator equivalence tests pass before the AWS smoke

run_control.results_embargo: No test prediction or derived test metric is read until the complete artifact audit passes.
